title: Harbour Fleet Boats & Yachts
text: Browse, Book, and Sail Sydney’s Finest Fleet.
description: A full-featured Sydney boat hire portal that allows users to explore available vessels, check real-time availability, customize cruise packages, and complete bookings online. Built with Angular and Bootstrap, the platform provides a smooth, responsive experience with secure payments, fleet management tools, and automated notifications—designed to streamline both customer booking and operator management workflows.
coreFeatures: Real-time boat availability and booking
Fleet catalog with photos, specs, and pricing
Custom cruise packages with optional add-ons
Weather updates and safety information
Secure payment flow with automated confirmations

title: Unient
description: Corporate website for Unient built on .NET and Umbraco CMS. Features content management, dynamic page creation, and enterprise-level architecture. Provides a professional online presence with easy content updates.

title: PPSTA
text: Philippine Public School Teachers Association - Insurance System
description: A web-based insurance management application for the Philippine Public School Teachers Association (PPSTA), the largest professional organization for public school educators in the Philippines with over 200,000 members nationwide. This system is a modernization of a legacy FoxPro desktop application, redesigned to support scalable, secure, and centralized operations.
tech: PHP, CakePHP, Bootstrap, JavaScript, MySQL, jQuery

testCredentials.instructions: Use the provided credentials to access the admin dashboard. Explore member management, insurance plans, claims processing, and reporting features.

coreFeatures: Member management and profiling
Insurance plan enrollment and tracking
Premium payment processing and history
Claims submission and status monitoring
Administrative dashboard with analytics and reporting
Role-based access control
projectHighlights: Modernized a legacy FoxPro desktop application into a scalable web-based system
Designed and built a custom FoxPro-to-MySQL data migration tool to ensure data integrity and continuity
Led and coordinated a team of developers, overseeing architecture decisions, task delegation, and code reviews
Implemented improved data structures and workflows to support long-term maintainability

title: Foxpro To MySQL Migration Tool
text: A tool to migrate Foxpro DBF files to MySQL database.
description: A WPF .NET C# application that reads Foxpro DBF files and migrates the data to a MySQL database. It supports batch processing of multiple DBF files, data type mapping, and error handling. The tool provides a user-friendly interface for selecting source files, configuring database connections, and monitoring migration progress.
highlights: Dual embedding providers: ML.NET TF-IDF (local, fast) and ONNX Runtime (neural networks)
384-dimensional vector embeddings with cosine similarity ranking
Customizable training data via training-data.json for domain-specific optimization
Auto-seeding with 22 diverse documents (Marvel movies, family films, tech concepts)
Modern responsive UI with Bootstrap 5 and real-time database status
Diagnostic endpoints for embedding testing, database status, and reseeding
Clean architecture with dependency injection and provider pattern
Production-ready with configurable providers via appsettings.json
coreFeatures: Reads Foxpro DBF files and extracts data
Maps Foxpro data types to MySQL data types
Supports batch processing of multiple DBF files
Has stop and resume releasedity
Displays migration progress and error handling

title: Semantic Search Web Api
description: A .NET 8 Web API demonstrating semantic search using vector embeddings. Supports ML.NET TF-IDF (local, default) and ONNX Runtime for neural network models. Search using natural language - e.g., 'billionaire superhero' finds Iron Man. Converts text into 384-dimensional vectors and uses cosine similarity for ranking. Features configurable providers, customizable training data, auto-seeding with sample documents, diagnostic endpoints, and a Bootstrap frontend.
highlights: Dual embedding providers: ML.NET TF-IDF (local, fast) and ONNX Runtime (neural networks)
384-dimensional vector embeddings with cosine similarity ranking
Customizable training data via training-data.json for domain-specific optimization
Auto-seeding with 22 diverse documents (Marvel movies, family films, tech concepts)
Modern responsive UI with Bootstrap 5 and real-time database status
Diagnostic endpoints for embedding testing, database status, and reseeding
Clean architecture with dependency injection and provider pattern
Production-ready with configurable providers via appsettings.json
coreFeatures: Understands meaning and intent, not just keywords
Uses embeddings/vectors to measure semantic similarity
Retrieves contextually relevant results even with different wording
Supports hybrid search (semantic + keyword)
Can rerank results using AI models for higher relevance

title: Business Permit Licensing System (LGU)
text: A digital platform for managing business permits and municipal licensing.
description: A municipality-level Business Permit Licensing System designed to streamline business registration, permit processing, and compliance workflows. Built with Laravel and Vue.js, the platform supports digital applications, automated fee computation, payment integration, document management, approvals, and real-time tracking. Developed with a responsive and modern interface to help local government units manage operations efficiently and improve service delivery.

testCredentials.instructions: Log in with the test credentials to explore the full licensing workflow—including business applications, fee computation, payments, document review, approvals, and analytics dashboards.

coreFeatures: Streamlined business registration and permit processing
Automated fee computation with payment integration
Digital document submission, review, and approval workflows
Real-time application and renewal status tracking
Reporting and analytics for LGU compliance and revenue monitoring
